raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Switching dlfash fp8 kv cache draft model

## Test

```bash
alias glm_serve_dflash="c 4 -- vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3    --trust-remote-code     -tp 4     --load-format fastsafetensors     --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88     --enable-prefix-caching     --host 0.0.0.0     --port 9256     --max-model-len auto     --max-num-seqs 48     --speculative-config '{\"method\":\"dflash\",\"model\":\"incoai/GLM-5.3-DFlash2\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":7}'"

alias bench="vllm bench serve --model $MODEL  --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 2 --random-output-len 1024 --max-concurrency 1 --num-prompts 32 --num-warmups 4 --trust-remote-code --temperature 0  --ignore-eos  --seed 256"  # --max-concurrency 8 --profile

alias bench_profile="vllm bench serve --model $MODEL  --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 2 --random-output-len 128 --request-rate inf --num-prompts 2 --num-warmups 1 --profile"
alias lm_eval="lm_eval run --model local-chat-completions --model_args base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/chat/completions,model=$MODEL,num_concurrent=1024,seed=256 --tasks aime25 --trust_remote_code --apply_chat_template"
```

files.patch:
@@ -126,7 +126,7 @@ def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
             spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
             if (
                 spec_config is not None
-                and spec_config.method not in ("mtp", "dspark")
+                and spec_config.method not in ("mtp", "dspark", "dflash")
                 and spec_config.kv_cache_dtype is None
             ):
                 spec_config.kv_cache_dtype = "auto"
